summary.description: A short summary for someone who has never programmed. Explain what they will see or can do, what is ready, and the next action. Avoid code paths, commit IDs, branches, PRs, build logs and programming jargon.

title.description: A clear pull-request title, under 100 characters, describing the intended overall change relative to main. Rewrite voice dictation into normal written English.

description.description: Two or three short lines describing the changes and checks performed. Do not copy the user's raw voice transcript.
